preconditions.description: The input must be a list.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in numbers)
preconditions.description: All elements in the list must be integers.

postconditions.description: The returned value must be one of the numbers in the input list.

postconditions.expression: len(str(return_value)) == max(len(str(x)) for x in numbers)
postconditions.description: The returned number must have the most digits among the numbers in the input list.

postconditions.expression: all(len(str(return_value)) >= len(str(x)) for x in numbers)
postconditions.description: The returned number must have at least as many digits as any other number in the input list.
